target.contig_interpretation: Retain source chain A residues 53-59, terminate that retained segment with /0, and generate a new chain of 55-65 residues.

success_criterion.bar_basis: Watson et al. define motif-scaffolding in-silico success using global RMSD <2 A, motif RMSD <1 A, and pAE <5. Their benchmark uses 100 designs per problem and reports problem-level rates. A 20% floor is preregistered for this bounded small-contiguous-motif campaign, using the previously recorded 19% multi-target operational precedent as a conservative reference; it is not an experimental-success claim.

measurement.global_superposition: RFdiffusion generated chain to Boltz-2 generated chain over corresponding CA atoms
measurement.motif_superposition: retained motif CA atoms measured after applying the global generated-chain Kabsch transform
measurement.sequence_recovery_baseline: generated-chain sequence returned by RFdiffusion backbone extraction

scope_statement: A passing design means only that RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and Boltz-2 were computationally self-consistent at the pre-registered RMSD thresholds. It says nothing about folding, stability, expression, binding, or function.
